notes: Peak 160 MF (12.5 ns clock); LINPACK TPP 110 MF

notes: Cray-2/4-256: peak 1951 MF; TPP 1226 MF

notes: Y-MP/8: 8 x 333 MF; TPP 2144 MF

notes: CM-5/1024 at LANL; first Top500 #1

name: ASCI White
notes: 7.226 TF Rmax from June 2001

name: Blue Gene/L
notes: Nov 2004 beta system; full system 367 TF Rpeak (2005), 596 TF (2007)

notes: First Rmax above 1 PF

name: Summit
notes: Later 200.8 PF Rpeak / 148.6 PF Rmax

notes: Later 537.2 PF Rpeak / 442.0 PF Rmax

notes: Pentium III 500 with SSE. Derived: 4 single-precision flops/clock. x87 double-precision peak 5.0e8

notes: Fixed-function, not programmable; weak figure
